Job Description:

DB Global Technology is Deutsche Bank's technology centre in Central and Eastern Europe. Since its establishment in 2013, Bucharest Technology Centre (BEX) has played an important role in delivering global technology products and services, contributing to the Bank's ongoing technology transformation.


We have a strong, hands-on engineering culture focused on continuous learning, knowledge sharing, technical development, and collaboration. Our teams develop and maintain applications supporting key business areas across the Bank.


We are looking for an experienced, technically oriented Business Analyst to join our Cards & Loyalty area within Private Bank.


The role involves working in a complex banking ecosystem, where multiple interconnected applications support end-to-end business processes. The Technical Business Analyst will play a key role in translating business needs into functional and technical requirements, understanding system interactions, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into clear, structured functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for solution design and implementation.
  • Understand and document end-to-end business processes, system interactions, and dependencies across a landscape of 8–9 interconnected applications.
  • Create and maintain process flowcharts, system interaction diagrams, and functional documentation to support solution design and development.
  • Analyze API integrations, data flows, and interfaces between applications, working closely with development teams to clarify integration requirements.
  • Perform impact assessments for new requirements and changes, identifying affected applications, interfaces, processes, and dependencies.
  • Act as a key coordination point between business stakeholders, Product Owners, software engineering teams, and other application teams to ensure alignment on requirements and solution design.
  • Facilitate cross-team discussions, requirements workshops, and technical refinements to clarify requirements, resolve dependencies, and drive implementation.
  • Support solution design by evaluating functional options and contributing to the definition of optimal target-state processes.
  • Document requirements, processes, and functional specifications in Confluence and Jira, ensuring consistency and traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Support backlog refinement, prioritization, SIT/UAT activities, and pre-go-live change management.
  • Contribute to the investigation and resolution of production issues by analyzing functional behavior, system interactions, and potential root causes.

 

Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Requirements Engineer, Technical Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a similar role within a complex IT environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Good technical understanding of distributed application architectures, system integrations, APIs (REST), and data flows.
  • Experience in creating process flowcharts, functional diagrams, and system interaction diagrams using tools such as Visio, draw.io, or similar.
  • Ability to understand API specifications, request/response structures, and JSON payloads, and to collaborate effectively with software engineers on integration topics.
  • Good understanding of banking processes and financial services, ideally within Cards, Payments, or Loyalty.
  • Experience working with multiple interconnected applications and coordinating requirements and dependencies across different development teams.
  • Good knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts, with the ability to perform basic data analysis and validation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical discussions.
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and drive complex topics toward resolution.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong ownership mindset, proactive approach, and ability to manage competing priorities in a complex delivery environment.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

 

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience with card processing, card lifecycle management, payment systems, or loyalty platforms.
  • Experience with API documentation tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI or Postman.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures, microservices, or asynchronous system integrations.
  • Experience in large-scale banking transformation projects involving multiple applications and cross-functional teams.
  • German language skills

Well-being & Benefits 

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.  

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness. 
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace. 
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.  
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts. 
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health. 

Physically thriving: We support you in managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-ups. 


Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.  

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays). 
  • Hybrid working model with 40% remote work. 
  • Options for flexible working hours. 
  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more. 

Financially secure: We support you in meeting personal financial goals during your active career and for the future. 

  • Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose. 
  • Meal vouchers, bonuses for referrals 

Interested in more: discover what our employees value in the Well-being & Benefits hub! 

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
